name: navigation/floating-dock
title: Floating dock
description: A compact toolbar whose items grow as the pointer approaches.

files.content:
export { DockItem, DockSeparator, FloatingDock } from './FloatingDock';
export type { DockItemProps, FloatingDockProps } from './FloatingDock';

keyboard.action: Move into the dock (to the last focused item) and out again.
Hide the visible label without moving focus.

notes: Follows the WAI-ARIA toolbar pattern: one Tab stop for the whole dock and arrow keys inside it (roving tabindex).
Each item has its label as real text (visually hidden), so its name does not depend on the tooltip.
Toggles expose `aria-pressed`; the current page link exposes `aria-current="page"` and shows a magenta mark that does not rely on colour alone (it is a shape).
Labels appear on hover and keyboard focus, stay while hovered, and can be dismissed with Escape (WCAG 1.4.13).
Resting item size is 44 × 44 px, meeting the enhanced target size guideline.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Items keep their resting size; only the hover colour changes.
